change_summary: Add an experiment-only overnight_gap_share_20 OHLCV field and sweep a risk multiplier for non-ETF/non-Commodity core signals in the same-day top quartile of that field.

mid_weak.state_note: rotation-heavy bull where strategy makes money but lags indexes

old_thin.state_note: mixed-to-weak older tape with lower win rate

field_check.note: This risk-allocation experiment does not depend on these fields.

rule_dependencies: OHLCV Open/Close series through signal day

hypothesis: Already-qualified core stock signals with top-quartile prior-20-day overnight-gap share are more event-driven and gap-risk exposed. A risk haircut should improve expected_value_score and tail risk without changing entry, exit, ranking, universe, news, or LLM logic.
known_risks: Moderate multiple-testing risk because this is adjacent to recent OHLCV daily-return-path scouts.
Older gap-vulnerability experiments used stop-distance, not historical overnight-gap path share.
If accepted, production parity requires shared feature and sizing implementation before use.
The 0x variant is effectively no-trade alpha and must clear trade-count and concentration guards.

market_regime_summary.mid_weak: rotation-heavy bull where strategy makes money but lags indexes
market_regime_summary.old_thin: mixed-to-weak older tape with lower win rate

next_retry_requires: Do not retry adjacent overnight_gap_share20 cutoffs or scalars on the same frozen windows without forward rows or a stronger replacement-value cohort.
Prefer candidate-pool/replacement-value evidence over more local price-path threshold sweeps.
notes: No JavaScript used. This is alpha_search, not measurement repair.

parameters.field_definition: sum(abs(open_t / close_t-1 - 1)) divided by sum(abs(close_t / close_t-1 - 1)) over the last 20 signal-known trading days

production_impact.promotion_required_if_accepted: Move overnight_gap_share_20 feature, top-quartile state, and risk haircut into shared feature_layer/risk_engine/portfolio_engine with tests, then rerun the same three-window protocol.

rejection_reason: Best variant failed Gate 4 because at least one fixed window regressed in expected_value_score.
sweep_summary: <stripped 115KB oversized field; full value retained in the experiment artifact>
why_not_other_changes: Skipped LLM soft-ranking because attribution rows remain sparse; skipped SEC/event/source, broad-market, clean-SPY-cap, Commodity-cap, DTE, and state-surface scalar/profile retunes because recent logs show repeated drawdown/sample failures or same-family gates. This tests a new production-visible OHLCV gap-share field instead of repeating downside-path, max20, or path-efficiency variables.
